new_packages.reason:
Sections ב-ג of Torah #61 contain an explicit, multi-statement bechina family that the Rebbe treats as an independent conceptual domain: the holy Jewish script (כְּתַב יִשְׂרָאֵל) as the material embodiment of transmitted divine wisdom. The Rebbe declares: 'הַסְּמִיכָה שֶׁסּוֹמְכִין אֶת הָרַב, וְהַכְּתָב, הֵם מִבְּחִינָה אַחַת' (ordination and writing share one bechina-nature). He then adds: 'כִּי הַכְּתָב הוּא גַּם כֵּן מִבְּחִינַת חָכְמָה' (writing IS an aspect of wisdom) and 'הַכְּתָב הוּא בְּחִינַת אוֹתִיּוֹת מַחְכִּימוֹת' (writing IS the wisdom-letters). The Zohar/talmudic citation makes the link canonical: 'בִּכְתַב בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא יִכָּתֵבוּ – זֶה סְמִיכָה' (the verse about 'not being written in Israel's writing' = ordination). And the evil mirror: 'מְגַלֶּה סוֹד, זֶה בְּחִינַת בִּטּוּל כְּתַב יָדֵנוּ' (the gossip = nullifying of holy script). This gives a 4-node bechina cluster (כְּתָב, סְמִיכָה, אוֹתִיּוֹת מַחְכִּימוֹת, בִּטּוּל כְּתַב יָדֵנוּ [evil pole]) centered on a shared essential nature: the holy letters of Israel as the material-world medium through which divine wisdom is transmitted from sage to sage and from generation to generation.

Why this is independent of existing packages:
- It is NOT Package 1 (חָכְמָה עִלָּאָה): Package 1 describes supernal wisdom at its transcendent root. The כְּתָב package describes its material crystallization into physical letters and the institutional mechanism (ordination) that keeps the chain of transmission alive. The Rebbe explicitly distinguishes: 'וְהַכֹּל בִּכְתָב מִיַּד ה' עָלַי הִשְׂכִּיל' — the heavenly sekhel (Package 1) flows DOWN into the writing (Package 5) through ordination. This is a Package 1 → Package 5 eitza flow, not a same-package bechina.
- It is NOT Package 2 (אֱמוּנַת חֲכָמִים): Package 2 describes the inner faith-quality and proper-judgment that flows from receiving the sages' teaching. The כְּתָב package describes the external institutional and textual vehicle — the written tradition itself. Faith (Package 2) attaches to the content; the script (Package 5) IS the medium.
- The good/evil mirror is internal to this package: כְּתַב יָדֵנוּ (holy script) and its negation בִּטּוּל כְּתַב יָדֵנוּ (nullified script) represent the two poles of the same domain, just as Package 3 mirrors Package 2.
new_packages.threshold_explanation: Four concepts with explicit bechina language form a coherent independent domain: (1) כְּתָב ('מִבְּחִינַת חָכְמָה'), (2) סְמִיכָה ('בְּחִינַת הַכְּתָב'), (3) אוֹתִיּוֹת מַחְכִּימוֹת ('הַכְּתָב הוּא בְּחִינַת אוֹתִיּוֹת מַחְכִּימוֹת'), (4) בִּטּוּל כְּתַב יָדֵנוּ ('זֶה בְּחִינַת בִּטּוּל כְּתַב יָדֵנוּ'). The threshold of 3+ concepts is met. The domain ('the holy letters as medium of transmitted wisdom') is not subsumed by any of the four proposed packages. The Rebbe himself declares these two elements — ordination and writing — as sharing 'one bechina,' which is the clearest possible warrant for a package.

proposed_edges_to_add.proof: הַסְּמִיכָה שֶׁסּוֹמְכִין אֶת הָרַב, וְהַכְּתָב, הֵם מִבְּחִינָה אַחַת. כִּי הַסְּמִיכָה בְּיָדַיִם... וְהוּא בְּחִינַת הַכְּתָב, בְּחִינַת יָד כּוֹתֶבֶת.
הַכְּתָב הוּא בְּחִינַת אוֹתִיּוֹת מַחְכִּימוֹת, וְעַל יְדֵי תְּנוּעוֹת הַקֻּלְמוֹס בָּאֲוִיר בִּשְׁעַת כְּתִיבָה, נֶחֱקָקִים בְּחִינַת הָאוֹתִיּוֹת מַחְכִּימוֹת בְּתוֹךְ הָאֲוִיר.
מְגַלֶּה סוֹד, זֶה בְּחִינַת בִּטּוּל כְּתַב יָדֵנוּ, שֶׁאֵין מְקַבְּלִין אוֹר הַשֵּׂכֶל מִידֵי הַסְּמִיכָה כַּנַּ"ל.

observations:
Torah #61 yields one proposed new package centered on the domain of 'the holy Jewish script as material embodiment of transmitted wisdom.' This domain is absent from the four bechina-connected packages because all four packages deal with (1) the transcendent root of divine wisdom, (2) its reception as uncorrupted judgment, (3) its corruption into distorted judgment, or (4) the mechanism of its renewal through controversy and teshuvah. None addresses the MEDIUM of transmission itself — the written letters, the ordination that charges those letters, and the wisdom-letters that sanctify the air. The Rebbe's declaration 'the ordination and the writing share one bechina' (Section ב) is the founding statement of this new package.

A second candidate examined but not recommended as a new package: the 'נְשָׁמָה / שָׁמַיִם / גַּלְגַּלְתָּא' cluster from Section ג. While the Rebbe does make two explicit נִקְרֵאת bechina statements ('הַנְּשָׁמָה נִקְרֵאת שָׁמַיִם' and 'הַנְּשָׁמָה נִקְרֵאת גַּלְגַּלְתָּא'), this cluster describes the soul as the all-governing intellect of the celestial spheres — a sub-theme within Package 1's domain of supernal wisdom and the soul. The נְשָׁמָה / שָׁמַיִם / גַּלְגַּלְתָּא triad is thematically contained within Package 1 (they are expressions of the same 'all-encompassing divine intellect' domain already anchored by שֵֹּכֶל הָעֶלְיוֹן and קָדְשֵׁי קֳדָשִׁים). The recommended action is to add these nodes to Package 1 as gap-additions (see torah_61_additions.json) rather than to create a separate package. Creating a new package here would fragment Package 1 without a clear conceptual boundary justifying the split.
